name: Yanran Lin
title: Graduate Research Assistant
bio: Yanran Lin is a PhD student in the Kahlert School of Computing at the University of Utah. Her research focuses on trustworthy mixed-reality and egocentric computing systems, including gaze- and attention-aware scene understanding, multimodal sensing, and reliable spatial computing. She is interested in developing human-centered AI systems that can interpret user attention and intent and operate reliably in complex real-world environments.

education.degree: B.S.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
B.S.E. in Electrical and Computer Engineering

research_statement: I develop trustworthy and human-centered sensing systems for mixed reality and egocentric computing. My work investigates how gaze, visual context, task knowledge, and spatial information can be combined to infer human attention and intent, support downstream activity understanding, and improve the reliability of XR systems in real-world environments.
